concurrency.battle: one transient battle effect; a newer battle event replaces it
concurrency.common: one transient explicitly requested common effect
concurrency.weather: one persistent weather effect independent of transient effects

events.emitWhen: after authoritative battle contact/damage resolution classifies the presentation as the original large-hit effect, before advancing to the next action presentation
once on entry to a confirmed Hyper presentation phase; never from a generic button press
only from a system whose original caller has been traced or from an explicitly labelled internal presentation preview
once when authoritative weather enters or leaves rain; never every frame

hardConstraints: The event bus is ephemeral and is never serialized.
A failed renderer or VFX load cannot change battle or weather state.
The presentation layer does not infer a hit, Hyper state, Spark caller, or rain state.
No private requestAnimationFrame or ticker is created.
Gate Earth is outside this contract and remains unmounted.
